from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

import asyncpg  # type: ignore[import-untyped]
import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not __import__("os").getenv("MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN"),
    reason="MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN not set",
)


async def _seed(pg_pool: Any, user: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tenant = user["tenant_id"]
    identity = user["identity_id"]
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            team = await conn.fetchval(
                "INSERT INTO teams (name, created_by_tenant_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id",
                f"shape-team-{uuid4().hex[:8]}",
                tenant,
            )
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO team_role_assignments (parent_team_id, member_kind, member_id, role_id, status, assigned_by_user_id)
                SELECT $1, 'user', $2, (SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key = 'owner' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'active', $2
                """,
                team,
                tenant,
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE tenant_identities SET default_team_id = $1 WHERE id = $2",
                team,
                identity,
            )

            root = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Root node', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'question', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-root-{uuid4()}",
            )
            child = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Child node', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'note', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-child-{uuid4()}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)",
                root,
                tenant,
                team,
                "Test Map",
                "live",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'position')",
                child,
                root,
                tenant,
            )
            map_key = f"map-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO slugs (memory_id, team_id, resource_type, slug, title) VALUES ($1, $2, 'map', $3, $4)",
                root,
                team,
                map_key,
                "Test Map",
            )

            # workflow (active)
            wf_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO team_workflows (tenant_id, team_id, name, is_active, version, created_by)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, TRUE, 1, $4) RETURNING workflow_id
                """,
                tenant,
                team,
                f"wf-{uuid4().hex[:6]}",
                tenant,
            )
            # stages
            st_todo = await conn.fetchval(
                "INSERT INTO workflow_stages (tenant_id, workflow_id, name, ordinal, is_initial, is_terminal) VALUES ($1,$2,'todo',0,TRUE,FALSE) RETURNING stage_id",
                tenant,
                wf_id,
            )
            st_done = await conn.fetchval(
                "INSERT INTO workflow_stages (tenant_id, workflow_id, name, ordinal, is_initial, is_terminal) VALUES ($1,$2,'done',1,FALSE,TRUE) RETURNING stage_id",
                tenant,
                wf_id,
            )
            st_other = await conn.fetchval(
                "INSERT INTO workflow_stages (tenant_id, workflow_id, name, ordinal, is_initial, is_terminal) VALUES ($1,$2,'other',2,FALSE,FALSE) RETURNING stage_id",
                tenant,
                wf_id,
            )
            # transitions
            tr_reason = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO workflow_transitions (tenant_id, workflow_id, from_stage_id, to_stage_id, requires_reason, requires_signoff, signoff_min)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,TRUE,FALSE,1) RETURNING transition_id
                """,
                tenant,
                wf_id,
                st_todo,
                st_done,
            )
            tr_signoff = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO workflow_transitions (tenant_id, workflow_id, from_stage_id, to_stage_id, requires_reason, requires_signoff, signoff_min, signoff_roles)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,FALSE,TRUE,1,ARRAY['member']) RETURNING transition_id
                """,
                tenant,
                wf_id,
                st_todo,
                st_other,
            )

            # work items
            def _wi(current_stage: str) -> UUID:
                return None  # placeholder

            # reason_required item
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, status, assignee_id, created_by, workflow_id, current_stage)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'story','todo',NULL,$3,$5,'todo')
                """,
                child,
                root,
                tenant,
                team,
                wf_id,
            )
            # We need separate memory nodes for each item; create two more children
            child2 = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Child2', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'note', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-child2-{uuid4()}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'position')",
                child2,
                root,
                tenant,
            )
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, status, assignee_id, created_by, workflow_id, current_stage)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'story','todo',NULL,$3,$5,'todo')
                """,
                child2,
                root,
                tenant,
                team,
                wf_id,
            )
            # awaiting signoffs item + pending request
            child3 = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Child3', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'note', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-child3-{uuid4()}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'position')",
                child3,
                root,
                tenant,
            )
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, status, assignee_id, created_by, workflow_id, current_stage)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'story','todo',NULL,$3,$5,'todo')
                """,
                child3,
                root,
                tenant,
                team,
                wf_id,
            )
            req_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO workflow_signoff_requests (tenant_id, work_item_memory_id, from_stage, to_stage, proposer_tenant_id, reason, status)
                VALUES ($1,$2,'todo','other',$3,NULL,'pending') RETURNING request_id
                """,
                tenant,
                child3,
                tenant,
            )

    return {
        "tenant": tenant,
        "team": team,
        "map_key": map_key,
        "child": child,
        "child2": child2,
        "child3": child3,
        "wf_id": wf_id,
        "req_id": req_id,
    }

async def test_shapes(client: Any, pg_pool: Any, user_personal: Any) -> None:
    s = await _seed(pg_pool, user_personal)
    team = s["team"]
    map_key = s["map_key"]
    cookies = {"mem_session": user_personal["session"]}

    # board list
    r = client.get(f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key}/work-items", cookies=cookies)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert "team_id" in data
    assert data["team_id"] == str(team)
    assert isinstance(data["items"], list)
    assert len(data["items"]) >= 1
    for item in data["items"]:
        for key in ("node_id", "team_id", "current_stage", "allowed_moves", "blocked_reason", "pending_signoff"):
            assert key in item, key

    # workflow
    r2 = client.get(f"/api/web/teams/{team}/workflow", cookies=cookies)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    w = r2.json()
    for key in ("workflow_id", "name", "is_active", "version", "stages", "transitions"):
        assert key in w, key
    stages = w["stages"]
    ordinals = [st["ordinal"] for st in stages]
    assert ordinals == sorted(ordinals)
    assert isinstance(w["transitions"], list)

    # pending signoffs
    r3 = client.get(f"/api/web/teams/{team}/workflow/pending-signoffs", cookies=cookies)
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    ps = r3.json()
    # endpoint returns list
    assert isinstance(ps, list)
    if ps:
        for row in ps:
            for key in ("node_id", "from_stage", "to_stage", "reason", "signoff_min", "signatory_count", "remaining"):
                assert key in row, key

    # cleanup
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_signoffs WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM work_items WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM work_item_history WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memory_map_membership WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memory_maps WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM slugs WHERE team_id = $1", team)
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM memories WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_transitions WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM workflow_stages WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM team_workflows WHERE tenant_id = $1", user_personal["tenant_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM team_role_assignments WHERE parent_team_id = $1", team)
            await conn.execute("UPDATE tenant_identities SET default_team_id = NULL WHERE id = $1", user_personal["identity_id"])
            await conn.execute("DELETE FROM teams WHERE id = $1", team)
